STEERING — Steering Column (USA)

SR-11

15. REMOVE TILT STEERING ADJUSTING NUT AND PIN

16. REMOVE TILT STEERING SUPPORT STOPPER BOLT
Remove the nut, support stopper bolt and cover.

17. REMOVE SERRATION BOLTS
Temporarily install the two nuts to the two serration bolts and for protection, and tap out the two serration bolts from the upper bracket.

18. REMOVE COLUMN UPPER BRACKET
(a) Remove the column upper bracket from the breakaway bracket.

(b) Remove the two bolts.
